title: VSON Extractor Response Envelope
description: JSON envelope returned by an image-to-VSON extractor. Carries the canonical Penman text, the derived Turtle, optional structured graph, and metadata. A consumer that only wants the graph reads .vson_p; a consumer that wants triples reads .vson_t; a consumer that wants nodes/edges for a UI reads .graph.

scene_id.description: Stable identifier for this scene. URL-safe, document-unique.

version.description: VSON spec version. "1.0" for v1.0 strict. "1.0.5" for v1.0 + caption renderer + Phase 0 ontology additions (vso:class, vso:modifier, Persona). "1.1" adds VSON-X surface form and partial validation profile. Backwards-compatible: every v1.0 envelope remains valid under newer spec versions.

source.description: Provenance of the scene. Optional. Producers SHOULD populate it for any non-hand-authored scene; this schema does not enforce that, it only requires source.kind once the object is present.

vson_p.description: VSON-P (Penman) authoring form. SHOULD be the canonical authoring artifact when extraction targets Penman. Consumers MUST round-trip vson_p -> vson_t via the reference transpiler and SHOULD NOT diverge from vson_t. v1.1: in VSON-X mode this field is the empty string "" (back-conversion to Penman is deferred to v1.2 when t2p ships); v1.1 envelopes MUST satisfy the if/then rule below — at least one of vson_p or vson_x is non-empty.

vson_t.description: VSON-T (Turtle 1.2 / Turtle-star) form derived from vson_p or vson_x. Consumers MAY parse this directly with rdflib or any Turtle parser. Always non-empty.

vson_x.description: VSON-X (compact sigil-based) form, optional. Populated when authoring/extraction surface was VSON-X. Spec: docs/vson-x-semantics.md. Available v1.1+.

graph.description: Optional structured projection for UI clients. Lossy w.r.t. RDF semantics (no RDF-star annotations). Use vson_t for full fidelity.

conformance.description: SHACL conformance report. Producers MUST run validation before emitting; consumers MAY trust the conforms flag without re-validating. Conforms is always interpreted within the chosen profile (see profile field).

profile.description: Validation profile. "strict" (default) uses shapes/vson-shapes.ttl (v1.0 byte-identical behavior). "relaxed" uses shapes/vson-shapes-relaxed.ttl (viewer anchoring / lemma / Quality dimension+value / Quality modifier downgraded to sh:Warning) for authoring-time documents; as of v1.1 no shipped command selects that file, so a producer sets this to "relaxed" only if it validated against it itself. v1.1+. Consumers MUST inspect both conforms and profile to determine document status; conforms=true under relaxed is NOT equivalent to v1.0 conformance.

violations.description: Empty when conforms=true under chosen profile.

extraction.description: Optional metadata about how this VSON document was produced.

allOf.$comment: v1.0 / v1.0.5: vson_p is the source of truth and MUST be non-empty.
v1.1: at least one authoring surface (vson_p or vson_x) MUST be non-empty. Either Penman extraction (vson_p non-empty, vson_x absent) or VSON-X extraction (vson_p='', vson_x non-empty).

class.description: Domain class for PhysicalObject / Aggregate / Substance.

label.description: VSO/Allen/RCC predicate local name (e.g. depicts, agent, before, EC).
